title: record details: Enter on a lookup link inside a copy-on-activate details row copies the row value instead of opening the link (the served approval request page's target card)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible keyboard defect, reproduced in a real browser. objectui#12557's dev reported it (PR objectui#12568, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, measured in jsdom only). The `domain:ui` seat 1's landing reading for that PR then confirmed it live. That PR does not change it: head and base behave alike.

finding · reach: a keyboard user on a record page whose `record:details` grid draws a copy-on-activate row (`role=button`, `tabindex=0`) that contains a link. On HotCRM `63db83e` the measured instance is the served `sys_approval_request_detail` page. The Details grid's "Record ID" row is a copy row, and the target-record card inside it draws an Account lookup link ("ACC-000002 - Globex Industries").
- Tab to that lookup link and press Enter. It does not navigate, and the row's raw value (`ViHKp_h_qq07iTZ7`) lands on the clipboard. This is the same on objectui `main` `a90c13178b` and on PR #12568's head.
- Mouse clicks are unaffected.
- On 15 HotCRM business record pages, every Details-grid lookup link sits in an inline-editable row with no copy handler, and Enter navigates there. So today's reach is the pointer card's inner links, wherever a `referenceVia` pair draws one.

**Producer (named by the dev's reading, not yet patched):** `DetailSection` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`), the copy row's `onKeyDown`. It calls `preventDefault` on Enter whatever the event's target is, which cancels a focused descendant link's own activation. PR #12568 stops Enter at its own title link (pinned and ablated); the lookup cell's `ReferencedRecordLink` (`@object-ui/fields`) does not.

**Reader who acts:** triage grades this card. The likely lane is `domain:ui`. The fix is probably in the row's handler: ignore keys whose target is an interactive descendant. It is not a per-link workaround. ⛔ This is not a claim.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T20:15Z): "Enter key on lookup link inside details row copies value instead of navigating keyboard DetailSection onKeyDown preventDefault" → 0 results.

## Acceptance (proposed)

- A test on the real `DetailSection` copy row containing a lookup link: Enter on the link navigates (the link's own activation is not default-prevented) and copies nothing. Enter on the row itself still copies (CONTROL).
- A browser reading on a served approval request page: Tab to the card's lookup link, then Enter, opens the account.

Attribution: filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 in session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB` (account `sunhaolin`), from the PR objectui#12568 landing reading.
